asks: Does the model answer the question, and both one-hop questions, right?
what_happened: Two-hop: says “Eight” (right answer “Eight”, P = 0.88). Hop 1 “Which animals spin webs? Answer in one word.” → “Spiders”. Hop 2 “How many legs does a spider have? Answer in one word.” → “Eight”.

asks: Is every edited word a single token?
Does removing the answer's own direction kill it, and from which layers?
what_happened: Remove the answer “Eight” itself: first kills it in layers 21–26 (P 0.88 → 0.13, drop 0.85). That's where the model starts writing the answer.

asks: Same question, asked to name the bridge first: does removing the bridge (before the answer onset) kill its name?
what_happened: Ask “How many legs do the animals that spin webs have? Answer in one word. First name the animal.” with the reply starting “The animal is” (model continues: “the spider, and it has”). Remove “spider” in layers 9–14 → P(“spider”) goes 0.94 → 0.84. Drop 0.10.

asks: Does removing the bridge, before the answer onset, kill the answer?
what_happened: Remove “spider” in layers 15–20 → P(“Eight”) goes 0.88 → 0.00. Drop 1.00.

asks: Is that drop bigger than removing everyday words of the same strength?
what_happened: Biggest drop from 12 everyday words: 0.05 (“garden”, layers 0–5). Bridge 1.00 − noise 0.05 = 0.95 (pass ≥ 0.5).

asks: Does the bridge start to matter at least 3 layers before the answer does?
what_happened: “spider” first matters from layer 9; the answer “Eight” from layer 21 → 12 layers earlier.

asks: Does removing the bridge matter more than removing another word of its kind with the same answer?
what_happened: Remove “ticks” (same answer) → P(“Eight”) goes 0.88 → 0.84. Drop 0.05. Bridge 1.00 − 0.05 = 0.95 (pass ≥ 0.3).

asks: Does the same edit leave unrelated questions alone?
what_happened: Same edit (layers 15–20): “What is the chemical symbol for gold? Answer in one word.” → P(“Au”) 1.00 → 1.00; “What is the largest planet in the Solar System? Answer in one word.” → P(“Jupiter”) 0.95 → 0.96. Biggest drop 0.00 (pass ≤ 0.1).

asks: What if the bridge is removed over many layers at once?
what_happened: Remove “spider” in layers 8–23 → P(“Eight”) 0.88 → 0.00 (drop 1.00); in all layers → 0.00 (drop 1.00).

asks: Does removing only the part of the bridge not shared with the answer still kill it?
Swap in another word: does the answer become that word's answer?
what_happened: 3 of 5 swaps gave the swapped word's own answer (fallback answer with the bridge removed: “4”).

asks: Swap in a word with the same answer: is the answer kept?
Need × specificity × isolation (0 if the bridge doesn't come first)
what_happened: Need 0.95 (drop beyond noise) × specificity 0.95 (share not matched by a same-kind word) × isolation 1.00 (share left when the part shared with the answer is kept) = 0.91.
